source.method: sparql:SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?article ?sitelinks ?melt ?boil WHERE { { SELECT ?item (MIN(?m) AS ?melt) (MIN(?b) AS ?boil) WHERE { ?item wdt:P31 wd:Q11344 ; p:P2101/psn:P2101/wikibase:quantityAmount ?m ; p:P2102/psn:P2102/wikibase:quantityAmount ?b . } GROUP BY ?item HAVING(COUNT(DISTINCT ?m)=1 && COUNT(DISTINCT ?b)=1) } hint:Prior hint:runFirst true . OPTIONAL { ?article schema:about ?item ; schema:isPartOf <https://en.wikipedia.org/> . } ?item wikibase:sitelinks ?sitelinks . SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en,mul". } } ORDER BY DESC(?sitelinks) LIMIT 160

rows.description: radioactive chemical element with symbol Pu and atomic number 94
rows.hook: powers spacecraft and nuclear reactors and is named after a former ninth planet

rows.label: oxygen

rows.hook: makes up about a fifth of the air we breathe and is needed for fire to burn

rows.label: sulfur

rows.label: potassium
